summary:
Fixed the LIS update logic. The original code unconditionally set `longest = length + 1` whenever it improved a tail (`val < arr[ends[length+1]]`), incorrectly growing the longest length. Corrected to only increase `longest` when `length == longest` (actual extension), otherwise just update `ends[length+1]` to improve the tail for that length.

RESULT: FIXED

+++ b/program.py

         length = max(prefix_lengths) if prefix_lengths else 0
 
-        if length == longest or val < arr[ends[length + 1]]:
+        if length == longest:
             ends[length + 1] = i
             longest = length + 1
+        elif val < arr[ends[length + 1]]:
+            ends[length + 1] = i
 
     return longest
